answer: Beacon-chained work receipts.** Each agent must include a verifiable beacon from its last 50 actions; a new identity can only accumulate receipts by replaying real work, and receipts expire unless refreshed by a fresh plume of independent task completions. Cloning splits receipt history, forcing the clone to redo the full river of prior work from zero. An attacker deploying N clones pays N × full work-history cost, so the marginal clone is always strictly negative-EV.
